title: MCP confused deputy / delegated authority — Splunk hunt (schema 1.4.0)
schema.name: agentsec.security_event
schema_version_note: LAB-MCP-001 searches/catalog.json schema.version=1.1.0 is documentation metadata. Q-MCP-*.spl does not filter on schema.version and is 1.4.0-compatible.

queries.security_question: What did CTRL-DELEGATION-001 decide, for which caller/deputy/tool, which authority source was used, and what downstream MCP decision and execution were indexed?

queries_not_created.reason: Q-MCP-DELEGATION already tables authority.source, hop-0 coded delegated scope, and the requested tool. A second hunt would duplicate the same row.
Caller, hop-1 deputy, and hop-1 delegator are already columns on Q-MCP-DELEGATION.
execution_observation plus existing Q-MCP-EXECUTED / Q-MCP-TOOL already cover indexed start/complete. Runtime handler count remains authoritative.
authority.source=ambient_deputy plus execution_observation are already on Q-MCP-DELEGATION. Publishing a second hunt would look like a detector.

detection.note: Reused unchanged. DET-MCP-006 not created. Detection analyzed; hunt is sufficient for Phase 7C.
